edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 30 Iesu Nave Hom. I 1

source_text: Donavit Deus nomen, quod est super omne nomen, Domino et Salvatori nostro Iesu Christo. Est autem nomen, quod est super omne nomen, Iesus. Ideo in nomine Iesu omne genu flectitur caelestium et terrestrium et infernorum. Multis generationibus a nullo cognominatum est. Moyses scripsit Genesim: Abraham et iusti plurimi, sed nullus Iesus meruit nominari. Iesu nomen primo invenio in Exodo: Venit Amalec et expugnabat Israel, et dixit Moyses ad Iesum in Raphidim. Moyses confitetur non posse se exercitum ducere; vocavit Iesum: Elige tibi viros potentes. Ubi primum disco nomen Iesu, ibi mysterium video: ducit exercitum Iesus.
pass_a_gloss: Gave God name, which is above every name, to-Lord and Savior our Jesus Christ. Is however name, which is above every name, Jesus. Therefore in name of-Jesus every knee is-bent of-heavenly and of-earthly and of-infernal. Through-many generations by no-one it-was-surnamed. Moses wrote Genesis: Abraham and righteous very-many, but no-one Jesus deserved to-be-named. Of-Jesus name first I-find in Exodus: Came Amalek and was-fighting Israel, and said Moses to Jesus at Rephidim. Moses confesses not to-be-able himself army to-lead; he-called Jesus: Choose for-yourself men powerful. Where first I-learn name of-Jesus, there mystery I-see: leads army Jesus.
pass_b_english: God [[gave the name that is above every name >> Bible:Philippians 2:9]] to our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. That name above every name is Jesus. Therefore [[in the name of Jesus every knee bows — of those in heaven and on earth and under the earth >> Bible:Philippians 2:10]]. Through many generations no one was called by it. Moses wrote Genesis: Abraham and many righteous men — yet none deserved to be named Jesus: not Abel, not he who [[began to call on the name of the Lord >> Bible:Genesis 4:26]], not Enoch, not Noah, not Abraham, not Isaac, not Jacob, not even Moses [[faithful in all God’s house >> Bible:Numbers 12:7]]. I first find the name Jesus in Exodus: [[Amalek came and fought Israel, and Moses said to Jesus at Rephidim >> Bible:Exodus 17:8-9]]. That is the first naming. Moses confesses he cannot lead the army; he calls Jesus: [[Choose for yourself strong men >> Bible:Exodus 17:9]]. Where I first learn the name Jesus, I also see the mystery: Jesus leads the army.
